title: Kinship with Johnny St. Cyr
summary: Watkins explains St. Cyr was his stepfather's brother, whom he considered an uncle, and mentions the death of St. Cyr's wife.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Well, while I think of it, I keep interrupting, I know you were related, you are related to Johnny St. Cyr, how was, can you explain, was it?
Well, you see that was my stepfather's brother.
I knew his stepfather was something.

Yeah, you see he's my stepfather's brother and naturally my stepfather brought me up from a child about six months or a year old. So I always just consider him as a father and Johnny St. Cyr as an uncle, see? And you heard about him losing his wife?
I think you all was up there at the time when it happened, didn't you? No, it's been about a year now though.
Well, last time I wrote to him, I wrote to him in 1957 from Frisco. But he's another one that's a very poor hand at writing anybody.
